# Smooth Lines

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Lines with their corners rounded: a moving average of each vertex and its neighbors (gaussian or boxcar), or a spline through the vertices (Catmull–Rom, cardinal, basis, natural, monotone, or a fixed turn radius). Other features pass through. Runs in the engine.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "smooth-lines", "name": "smooth-lines", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:windowSize`, or read elsewhere as `ch('smooth-lines/windowSize')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
